report_comment.text: CARS1 encodes cytoplasmic cysteinyl-tRNA synthetase. ALK encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase involved in neural development. CARS1::ALK was identified in primary and metastatic lesions of an inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor by fusion transcript analysis. The reported junction retains the carboxy-terminal ALK catalytic region. Crizotinib is US-approved for ALK-positive unresectable, recurrent or refractory inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor in adults and children aged at least 1 year.
